title: Texas Housing Crash 2026: 10 Texas Cities Where Home Prices Are About to Collapse
description:
#texashousing #housingcrash #realestate

Is the Texas housing boom finally breaking?

In this video, Discover the Nation counts down 10 Texas cities where home prices are about to crash in 2026.From coastal Corpus Christi and desert El Paso to tourism powered Waco, military driven Killeen and major metros like San Antonio, Houston, Fort Worth, Dallas, Frisco and Austin, we break down the warning signs you are not seeing on the glossy real estate ads. Rising inventory, thinning demand, higher mortgage rates, brutal property taxes, insurance shocks and local wages that can not keep up. City by city, we show you where the Texas story is bending from boom to possible bust.

If you are thinking about buying in Texas, already own here, or are just trying to understand where the next housing market cracks may appear, this deep dive is for you. We walk through the risks behind short term rentals, investor heavy neighborhoods, military and energy dependent job bases, and suburban communities that were priced for perfection.
